imports.py.summary: Generate a ``requirements.txt`` by inspecting the Python files of a project.
details: Collects the third-party imports with ast, resolves their installed versions, skips the local packages and the stdlib and writes the pinned requirements; ``-s`` writes a separate file per subdirectory.

imports5.py.summary: Generate a ``requirements.txt`` offline (local package list) or online (PyPI API).
details: Scans the sources (ast or line-based, notebooks included), normalises the import names through the PyPI mapping, detects the local modules and resolves the versions either from a local package list (``offline``) or from the PyPI JSON API (``online``), with a diff and a dry-run option.

Subcommands: ``check-missing`` finds the used names without an import (spec, stdlib or mapped strategy) and can insert them, ``check-position`` flags the imports placed after code or inside a scope, ``add-import`` prepends an import, ``check-load`` imports the files to catch runtime errors, ``find-py2`` detects the Python-2 import styles and ``transform`` rewrites ``import m; m.x`` as ``from m import x``.

inject-info.py.summary: Inject the personal details of ``~/.myinfo`` into a project's metadata files.
details: Reads the name, e-mail and GitHub username (plus the extra fields), applies the substitutions to ``setup.py``, ``setup.cfg``, ``pyproject.toml``, ``MANIFEST.in``, ``tox.ini`` and ``Pipfile`` and offers ``--dry-run`` and ``--diff``.

inplace_translator.py.summary: Translate text files in place with ChatGPT (Gemini fallback).
details: Loads the API key from ``.env``, collects the files of ``-e`` extensions (``txt``/``md`` by default), translates each of them into ``-l`` language and overwrites the original.
inplace_translator.py.notes: Needs an OpenAI or Gemini API key and replaces the content of the source files.

details: Subcommands: ``custom2json``/``ss2json`` parse the custom delimited dumps, ``freeze2json`` parses pip freeze, ``jsonl2dict``/``jsonl2json`` convert the JSONL files (per object or per directory), ``lowerkeys`` lowercases the keys, ``merge-json``/``mergejson`` combine the documents, ``mime2json`` wraps a MIME file and ``sortdict``/``tojson`` normalise the output.

junktools.py.summary: Filesystem cleanup toolkit for OS junk, caches, empty files and twins.
details: Subcommands: ``os-junk`` removes the Windows/macOS leftovers, ``darwin`` the ``.DS_Store``-style files, ``caches`` the ``__pycache__``/``.mypy_cache``/``.pyc`` items, ``empty-files``/``empty-dirs`` the empty entries (with the optional keypress window) and ``twins`` the files that share a stem with another extension.

klv.py.summary: Keep the newest package files and filter the ARMv7 wheel URLs to the latest versions.
details: The ``urls`` subcommand parses the wheel URLs and keeps the newest Android/linux-arm build of each package, ``clean`` deletes the older wheel/deb/tar.gz files of a directory (``--dry-run`` previews, ``--backup-dir`` moves them) and ``metadata`` prunes the older ``.metadata`` files.

Subcommands: ``move-chinese`` moves the files containing Chinese characters, ``filter-lines`` strips the non-English lines out of one file, ``find-files`` reports the non-English files with pycld2 and ``find-lines`` collects the non-English lines of a tree into a TSV (the strict mode adds gcld3 plus an NLTK word ratio).

Subcommands: ``collect`` concatenates the discovered license files into one file, ``clear`` empties them and ``strip`` removes the license text patterns (read from ``-p``) from every non-binary file, with ``-g`` separating the patterns by blank lines.

Subcommands: ``prefix``, ``append``, ``unescape-nl``/``escape-nl``, ``wrap``, ``get-range``, ``join``, ``move-range``, ``sort-length``, ``strip-ws``, ``tabs`` and ``space-out`` transform the lines of one file or of a whole tree, in place, to ``-o`` or to stdout.

Subcommands: ``stems`` prints the file stems truncated at the first dash, ``dirs`` the directory names with a ``-`` prefix and ``ls`` a listing with colours, icons, sizes, git status, a tree mode and a JSON output, with sorting and filter options.

lz4er.py.summary: LZ4 compression tool for files and folders.
details: ``compress`` writes ``.lz4`` for the files and ``.tar.lz4`` for the folders (``--mode auto|files|folders``), ``decompress`` reverses it, and the level, minimum size, chunk settings, the skip list and ``--keep`` control the behaviour.

The ``check`` subcommand reports the files without a guard and ``fix`` adds one by moving the top-level code into ``main()`` (``--method ast``) or by appending the guard (``--method regex``); ``--dry-run`` and ``--exclude`` are available.

mdv.py.summary: View a Markdown file in the terminal, page by page.
details: Renders the Markdown with rich and pages through it with the space/arrow keys, quitting with ``q``.

The ``join`` subcommand concatenates the CSS files of the given directories into one file and rewrites the Google-Fonts imports and the remote ``@font-face`` URLs to ``--font-dir``, ``minify`` runs the ``cleancss`` utility at the requested ``-l`` optimisation level.
